AdStrat bookmark: full code

Use this if the short bookmark says it "could not load". Same code, nothing loaded from the internet. 4,971 characters.

  1. Copy the code above (or tap in the box, Select all, Copy).
  2. Edit your Copy AdStrat claims bookmark: delete its address and paste this code. It must start with javascript: and end with sage)}.
  3. On your AdStrat claims list, tap the bookmark, then Copy for tracker.
  4. In the tracker: Claims → ⟳ Sync from AdStrat.

Nothing happens when you tap the bookmark?

Make a second bookmark with this tiny test code, then tap it on your AdStrat claims list. If a message pops up, bookmarks work there and the problem is the long code (often cut off when pasted). If nothing pops up, the browser isn't running bookmarks on that page.
